source_name: IRS, Identity and tax return verification service (CP5071 series letters)
text:
Department of the Treasury
Internal Revenue Service
Letter 5071C
Date: September 18, 2026
Tax year: 2025

We received a federal income tax return with your name and taxpayer identification number. To protect you from identity theft, we need to verify your identity before we can process the return.

What you need to do
Verify your identity online at www.irs.gov/verifyreturn. You will sign in with your IRS account. Have this letter, your 2025 tax return and your prior-year return ready.
If you can't verify online, call us at 800-830-5084. Our hours are Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
If you did not file this return, tell us so we can protect your account.

We can't process the return until you verify your identity. Please respond within 30 days from the date of this letter.
Wait 2 to 3 weeks after you verify before checking your refund at www.irs.gov/refunds.
